 SELECT mw.bap_id,

    mw.delivery_pincode,
    mw.retail_category,

    mw.motorable_distance,

    date_trunc('minute'::text, mw.f_at_pickup_from_date) AS f_at_pickup_from_date,
    date_trunc('minute'::text, mw.f_agent_assigned_at_date) AS f_agent_assigned_at_date,
    date_trunc('minute'::text, mw.delivered_date) AS delivered_date,
    date_trunc('minute'::text, mw.cancelled_date) AS cancelled_date,
    date_trunc('minute'::text, mw.picked_date) AS picked_date,
    date_trunc('minute'::text, mw.promised_time_to_deliver) AS promised_time_to_deliver,
    mw.awb_number AS awbnumber,
    o."Buyer NP" AS buyer_np,
    o."Seller NP" AS retail_snp,
        CASE
            WHEN o."Network order id" IS NULL THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END AS "Linked Orders",
    mw.rn_retail AS dedup,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.rn_order = 1 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS order_count,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.order_status::text = 'Completed'::text AND mw.delivered_date IS NOT NULL AND mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.delivered_date - mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date) / 60::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS avg_del,
    round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.promised_time_to_deliver - mw.order_created_at) / 60::numeric, 0) AS del_tat_duration,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.order_status::text = 'Completed'::text AND mw.delivered_date IS NOT NULL AND mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN
            CASE
                WHEN mw.delivered_date <= mw.promised_time_to_deliver THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS del_adherence,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.order_status::text = 'Completed'::text AND mw.delivered_date IS NOT NULL AND mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL AND mw.promised_time_to_deliver IS NOT NULL AND mw.delivered_date > mw.promised_time_to_deliver THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.delivered_date - mw.promised_time_to_deliver)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS del_breach_diff,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date - mw.order_created_at)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS rtsvscrt,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.picked_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.effective_pickup_date - mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS rtsvspck,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.order_status::text = 'Completed'::text AND mw.delivered_date IS NOT NULL AND mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.delivered_date - mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date) / 60::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS delage,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.order_status::text = 'Cancelled'::text THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.cancelled_date - mw.order_created_at)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS cancel_secs,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.order_status::text <> ALL (ARRAY['Completed'::character varying, 'Cancelled'::character varying]::text[]) THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - mw.order_created_at::timestamp with time zone) / 60::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS in_process_ageing,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.f_at_pickup_from_date IS NOT NULL AND mw.picked_date IS NOT NULL THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.picked_date - mw.f_at_pickup_from_date) / 60::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS rider_waiting,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.f_agent_assigned_at_date IS NOT NULL AND mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.f_agent_assigned_at_date - mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date) / 60::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS rider_assigning,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.pickup_tat IS NOT NULL AND mw.effective_pickup_date IS NOT NULL THEN
            CASE
                WHEN mw.effective_pickup_date <= mw.pickup_tat THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS pick_up_breached,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.pickup_tat IS NOT NULL AND mw.effective_pickup_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.effective_pickup_date - mw.pickup_tat)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS pick_up_tat_diff,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.rts_tat IS NOT NULL AND mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN
            CASE
                WHEN mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date <= mw.rts_tat THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS rts_breached,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.rts_tat IS NOT NULL AND mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date - mw.rts_tat)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS rts_tat_diff
   FROM masked mw
     LEFT JOIN analytics_insight.order_level o ON o."Network order id"::text = mw.retail_order_id::text;
